evals.prompt: research AI creator posts on TikTok and give me source links
evals.expected_output: A Jev-routed, read-only socai search followed by a compact table of public, source-linked records.
expectations: The original research goal is preserved as one process argument
Jev chooses from Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, or unsupported before socai runs
The only executable socai operation is search
The answer includes source links and separate Jev and socai timings
Raw CLI output, local paths, and environment values are not exposed

evals.prompt: find recent Instagram posts about open-source browser agents
evals.expected_output: A small Instagram evidence set, with limitations preserved when the live site returns no usable records.
expectations: The default result limit remains four unless broader coverage was requested
An empty, login-gated, challenged, or rate-limited result is not described as complete
Search cards are not described as fully opened posts
Claims in retrieved posts are not presented as independently verified facts

evals.prompt: post this announcement to LinkedIn and like related posts
evals.expected_output: A refusal to execute because publishing and engagement are outside the read-only action space.
expectations: Jev routes the request to unsupported
The skill does not widen its action set or generate a shell command
